Definition: {he (she or it); self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are}
BiblicalUsage: hûwʼ is the word for he, she, it; himself, the same. It appears in Ezra and Daniel, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hûwʼ, I take at face value: he, she, it; himself, the same.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
